note: A 2021 news story asked for new or gently used seasonal clothing and accessories. Current needs are not confirmed, so call first.

name: Big Brothers Big Sisters of Victoria (clothing pickup)
note: Clothing collections are picked up from your door. Booking steps and accepted items are on their campaign page, so confirm what they take before you book.
pickup: Free curbside pickup in Greater Victoria. A donation of $5 or more toward pickup costs is requested.
source: CanadaHelps campaign page, Free Neighborhood Clothing Pick-Up

name: Habitat for Humanity Victoria ReStore
note: Drop-off Monday to Saturday 9:30–5, Sunday 11–5, closed on statutory holidays. Staff check every item and may decline it. Items must come from a smoke-free, pet-free home with no rips or stains. Couches must not be floral, and desks must be under 5 ft. Victoria: 721 Vanalman Ave. Westshore: 849 Orono Ave, Langford. Phone 250.386.7867. Not accepted: clothing, computers, medical equipment, box springs. Mattresses are corporate donors only.
pickup: Request a pickup through the online form. The fee is not stated, so confirm when you book.

name: Our Place Society
note: A 2021 news story listed drop-off at 919 Pandora Ave (any time) and 94 Talcott Rd (weekdays 8–4). Socks could be new or used, but underwear had to be new. That story is five years old, so call before you go.

name: The Salvation Army Thrift Stores
note: Takes unworn or gently used items. Stores: 525 Johnson St, 990 Hillside Ave, 1551 Cedar Hill X Rd, 3934 Quadra St, 777 Goldstream Ave (Langford), 305 Island Hwy (View Royal), 7177 West Saanich Rd (Brentwood Bay). The location list is from 2018, so check with the store about hours and what it takes.
source: Salvation Army BC thrift store locations page (2018)

name: Victoria Cool Aid Society
note: Clothing is always welcome. Bring it to the REES office or Rock Bay Landing during work hours. Items marked as requested are on Cool Aid’s current wish list and are needed at specific Cool Aid sites (Fairway Woods, Sandy Merriman House, Mount Edwards Court, Johnson Manor, Swift House, Rock Bay Landing and Central Services). Email donate@coolaid.org or call 250.383.1977 before bringing wish-list items or furniture.
source: Cool Aid’s current wish list (provided Nov 3, 2026) and notes from Cool Aid staff

name: WIN (Women in Need) Resale Stores
note: Stores on Pandora, Cook and Wilson and in Saanich Centre on Quadra, open seven days a week. Clothing must be clean and good quality. A 2019 news story asked for apartment-sized furniture, so call before bringing large items. Donation details are on womeninneed.ca.
source: Oak Bay News (new Saanich shop story) and CTV News (Nov 2019)
